Definition: to depress or sink (expectation figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be or become low, sink, be humbled, be abased; 1a) (Qal) to be or become low; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to lay or bring low, humiliate; 1b2) to set in a lower place, show abasement; 1b3) to make low, sit down
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
